_comment: sim-collect-reposition-block-v1. Purpose: stop the mid-collect 'drive->rollwagen' reposition (to place_approach_stage) failing with blocked_no_route_timeout because the LOADED base drifted off its departure pose. In boxc1a (collect-only) the grasp held the base rock-steady (nav-trace: max |yaw| 0.2 deg), but once the reposition started every blocked/stopped tick issued mobile.command(0,0,...) which RELEASES the base parking/full brake 'to resume driving' even with NO route; port.advance() steps physics with the PRIOR tick's brake state (it re-engages the full brake only AFTER world.step), so the un-pinned chassis rolled ~0.28 m NORTH + ~0.13 m WEST under the carried carton's cantilever moment, into the LIVE backstock Support, flipping free_start False (in_start~=15) and making the short reposition permanently unroutable. (The brief's '~15 deg grasp yaw' was a misread of the planner's in_start=15 obstacle-POINT count; measured grasp yaw was 0.2 deg.) The single key below HOLDS the base pinned on a stopped reposition tick so it stays on its proven-clear departure pose, where a route exists with OR without the trusted-static drive. Absent/false => mobile.command(0,0) as before (byte-identical).
_runtime_block: Merge into the mission RUNTIME config block (read by scripts/twin/restock/isaac_bundle.py -> RuntimeAdapter, the orchestrate process).
_hold_base_on_reposition_block_note: On a non-driving tick (linear==0 AND angular==0) of the UNCOUPLED mid-collect carry reposition (_collect_reposition_pending), hold the base with mobile.hold() instead of mobile.command(0,0,...). mobile.hold() never releases the already-engaged full base brake (isaac_port._apply_base_brake engages it every transit tick) and locks the wheels, so a blocked/settling reposition tick can no longer let the carried load drift the base off the departure pose. A tick that commands ANY motion (tracking / turn-in-place / forward creep) still drives through mobile.command, so when the planner HAS a route the leg drives normally -- the hold only engages when the planner is stuck. Scoped to the collect reposition; every other navigate leg is byte-identical. Validated in scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_reposition_hold.py.
_requires: The reposition legs must already carry the existing trusted-static + carry keys so that, once the base is held near the clean departure pose, the planner routes it: carry_reposition_drive:true (the reposition dispatches static_drive=True + carry_drive internally; see runtime.py _start_nav_leg at the transit gate) and a place_approach + place_approach_stage mission pose. Register hold_base_on_reposition_block (RUNTIME) in the run's --require preflight if the lane enforces one.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Collect-only GPU run (the boxc1a config: RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, TRANSFER_MODE=live_pose, cage_collision filtered, transfer_carry weld+wrist_guard, stop_after collect) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with hold_base_on_reposition_block:true merged into the RUNTIME block. PASS CRITERIA: (1) collect COMPLETES (the 'drive->rollwagen' reposition reaches place_approach, the deck place + stow run, collect reports DONE), NOT blocked_no_route_timeout; (2) the base yaw drift during the grasp stays < 2 deg AND the base xy drift during the reposition stays < 0.10 m -- graded directly off the run's mission.json + nav-trace.jsonl by `python3 scripts/check_reposition_base_drift.py --run <run-dir>` (exit 0 = PASS). On the UNFIXED boxc1a that grader prints REPOSITION_BASE_DRIFT FAIL (grasp 0.00 deg PASS; reposition 0.302 m FAIL, north 0.278 m). GPU is serialised through the integration lane; never run a GPU mission from the worker lane.
